subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage clarification and remediation evidence request (PayCo)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@payco.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & evidence for finding 2027-04-A03

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. During our internal audit we flagged a control exception related to the privileged access logging window for the period covered by your Type II (finding 2027-04-A03). Our external auditors have asked for three things so we can close the loop on our end:  

- A copy of your SOC 2 Type II report covering 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 (or confirmation of coverage dates)
- A signed bridge letter if the issue remains an open exception during the audit window
- Evidence that remediation was implemented (or a management response + timeline if still in progress) — ideally containing system logs, configuration snapshots, or runbooks showing the fix applied

Can you confirm whether you can provide the bridge letter + evidence by Friday 2027-06-25? Our auditors will need documentation uploaded to our secure collection portal. If there is a specific format you prefer (zip, PDFs, or DocuSign for signatures), let me know and I will confirm with our team.

Appreciate it — we want to keep our audit timeline intact.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager, PayCo
Audit: +1 415 555 0123

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@payco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & evidence for finding 2027-04-A03

Hi Liam,

Thanks for the detailed note — we can support this. I'm looping in Marissa from Security Ops and Vivek (audit liaison) to assemble the artifacts and draft a bridge letter if needed. A few quick clarifying items so we can package the right evidence:  

1) When you say "privileged access logging window," can you share the specific time range or auditor note you received (i.e., the exact timestamps they expect evidence for)? If you only have the finding ID (2027-04-A03) that's fine — Marissa can cross-reference.
2) Do your auditors want native system logs (syslog/CloudTrail-style records) or summarized PDF evidence (config snapshots + explanation)? We can provide both but want to ensure we meet their ingest requirements.

Proposed next steps: Marissa will prepare a remediation actions summary and evidence bundle (PDF + zip of redacted logs). We'll also draft a one-page bridge letter for signature and a management response with planned/implemented actions. We expect a first package by Thu 2027-06-17 EOD and can follow with any additional items.

If that timeline works, we'll upload the package to the DocuSign/secure portal you prefer and share a download link.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Compliance, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 650 555 4301

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@payco.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & evidence for finding 2027-04-A03

Naomi / Vivek / Liam —

Quick status update and what's attached:  

- Attached: remediation-actions-summary.pdf (one-page timeline + owner list)
- Attached: evidence-batch-20270617.zip (contains redacted syslog segments, auth config snapshot, and the change request record)
- Attached: bridge-letter-draft.docx (for your review — includes acknowledgment of the exception and description of the compensating/control remediation applied)

Notes on remediation:  
- Root cause: a misconfigured log retention policy that excluded a small set of ephemeral admin nodes during a rolling upgrade in Apr 2027.
- Fix applied: retention policy corrected, CI job added to validate retention across all clusters, and an automated alert created for any cluster failing the retention check. The fix was deployed to all production clusters on 2027-05-20 at 03:45 UTC.
- Evidence provided: sample redacted logs from the affected window, change request ID CR-20270512, and a screenshot of the CI job run (run id: ci-78912).

Remaining ask from our side: can PayCo confirm whether a one-page signed bridge letter is acceptable for auditors (we've drafted one), or whether they require a notarized form or additional notarized statements? We'll hold off on DocuSign until you confirm.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: remediation-actions-summary.pdf (PDF), evidence-batch-20270617.zip (ZIP partial), bridge-letter-draft.docx (DOCX)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@payco.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & evidence for finding 2027-04-A03

Thanks team — the package looks good on first pass. A few quick items auditors asked to confirm before closing the finding:  

1) Please confirm that the retention policy fix deployed on 2027-05-20 was applied to "all production clusters" (you mentioned all, want explicit confirmation).
2) We'd like the signed bridge letter (DocuSign is fine). Please send the DocuSign when ready; auditors will accept a standard signed bridge letter acknowledging the exception and the remediation timeline.
3) If possible, add one-line confirmation in the management response that the automated alert has been validated with at least one test alert run (timestamp + run id).

If you can get the signed bridge letter and a short confirmation note on (1) and (3) uploaded to our portal by 2027-06-25, we should be able to clear the finding in our audit. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Liam
